title: DCCQ: From Ordered Bernoulli Levels to Critical-Line Geometry: Integer Quantization, Bernoulli Residual Phase, and Prime-Power Spectra
summary: We present the discrete--complex complement quotient (DCCQ) framework through the ordered Bernoulli-word kernel $f(p,n,k)=p^k(1-p)^{n-k}$ and its inverse-integer level sets. The binary level $2^{-n}$ selects $p=1/2$ as the unique real split-independent anchor. Imposing the additional continuation rule $1-z=\overline z$ gives the conjugation-symmetric line $z=1/2+iu$. On the central normalized branch, the inverse-level split $κ=k/n$ also has real part $1/2$.
